title: QA run · surface:browser (65/65) · 36b2889c · 2026-10-12 · 50 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 12 FAIL / 1 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
Half 2 of #23104, browser selector. The maintainer's order, verbatim: 「objectui pin 更新到最新版，并使用浏览器对前端界面进行完整的测试」. Every runnable `surface:browser` item was driven in a real browser against objectstack `36b2889c` with the console built from the new objectui pin `1fb1ced36243` (a local stand-in for PR #23110's head, explained below). The `surface:mixed` record for the same subject is filed separately, and this record's closeout comment links it. Text only: screenshots were consulted live as oracles and are not attached. The durable truth stays in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/`.

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework (subject):** `objectstack-ai/objectstack` **`36b2889cddc5e38acf7f85b8e186b02e6ef786c6`** (`test(plugin-security): retire the declared-permission seeder suites (#22897)`), in the detached worktree `/home/user/objectstack-qa-23104`, framework and console built.
- **Console:** `.objectui-sha` set LOCALLY to **`1fb1ced36243c325acc801bdde26bd096a15f5f5`**, with `sdui.manifest.json` and `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` regenerated from the built objectui tree at that pin (sha256 `f545b851c4bb…`, byte-identical to PR #23110's). The console dist stamp equals the pin, both in `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` and as served by `GET /_console/.objectui-sha`. Console source questions were read at that revision.
- **Why this tree stands in for the pin PR:** it differs from PR #23110's head `043b81d13` only in pin-citation strings inside spec descriptions, the sdui-parser lockstep JSON, two changesets and one docs reference page. Runtime code and console bundle are identical. PR #23110 has since landed on `main` as `f451a5964`, and the first full-battery `main` run carrying it (CI push run `38332364381` at `bcebd8409`) passed, `Console Pin Gate` included.
- **Checklist:** items, `RUNNER.md` and `scripts/checklist-select.mjs` come from the subject tree. Every item's revision is in the table and matches the selector's output.
- **App / boots:** `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:/tmp/qa-23104/LANE/ITEM.db`, with `OS_PORT` exported and a per-boot `OS_HOME` and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT`. Lanes A / B / C used the disjoint port ranges 44100–44399 / 44400–44699 / 44700–44999. Browser: Playwright on `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, one context per item. Admin `admin@objectos.ai` came from `--seed-admin`. Other personas were minted per item (invite + sign-up, or `admin/create-user` + `change-password`), and identity was proven with `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` before each persona cell.
- **Execution:** three parallel runner subagents (lanes A, B, C) in Claude Code session `session_016JB93R2KcQP4GgKaUnseVF`, dispatched by the PM seat `domain:devx#2`, from about 23:30Z on 2026-10-12 (lane C from 23:42Z). A container restart around 02:30Z killed all three mid-run. Each lane resumed from its own surviving results file at 02:33–02:34Z: judged items were kept byte-identical, and the not-run items (A 16, B 12, C 11) were re-run from scratch on fresh `-r2` state (DB, `OS_HOME`, storage root). The lanes finished on 2026-10-13 (C 03:32Z, B 03:57Z, A 04:28Z). Concurrency stayed at three lanes. Tier-1 pins that live in this repository ran batched under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (`--maxWorkers=2`) and are cited. Items whose `automated.ref` lives only in objectui were driven by hand, and objectui pins were run from an objectui checkout at the pin where the lane could.
- **RUNNER rule 7:** the one P0 fail (`platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render` A2) was re-derived independently by the PM seat from objectui source at the pin before it was filed (objectstack-ai/objectui#12285).
- **Hop regression: none.** No fail's cause lies inside the hop's 11 objectui commits (`7578323a544e..1fb1ced36243`). Every fail clause records `hop_suspect: false`, and the console-side fails in `conditional-rules-grid`, `calendar-interactions`, `concurrent-edit-conflict` and `console-installability-indicators` carry an explicit hop-range `git log` over the implicated files that returned empty.
- **Deviations, stated:**
  - **CRM manifest in the shared tree for 25 s.** Lane B's first marketplace boot-B attempt ran from the tree. Its inline `install-local` POST wrote `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/com.example.crm.json` into the shared tree from 03:44:53 to 03:45:18Z. `install-local` caches relative to the working directory and is not redirected by `OS_HOME` or `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT`. The package was removed through `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/com.example.crm`, the empty directory was removed, and `git status` was unchanged afterwards. Lane A confirmed that no boot of its started in that window. Its two boots running across it scored no clause on the app list, and its next boot served only `showcase_app, setup, account`. Boot B was re-run from a scratch copy.
  - **Declared shared boots.** Lane B ran many items on S1 (read-only/platform, 44401) and S2 (identity/access, 44402). Lane C's `studio1` boot hosted three studio items. `lifecycle-retention-sweep` and `interrupted-migration-boot-report` shared one DB and boot sequence. Each item records which boot it used.
  - **Scratch copies, never the tree.** Pinned Playwright smoke suites (`nav-surfaces-render` A0, `view-type-gallery` A5) ran from byte-identical scratch copies so their state stays out of the read-only tree. Scratch showcase copies under `/tmp/qa-23104/` carried app-level fixtures: palette visibility leaves, capability probes, walled-posture boots, the picklist fixture, marketplace boot B and job fixtures.
  - **Non-default boots, per item:** `OS_LOG_LEVEL=info`, `OS_LOCALIZATION_TIMEZONE` / `OS_MAIL_SMTP_PASSWORD`, `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group|isolated`, `OS_PAGE_REACT=off`, `OS_CLOUD_URL=off`, the scheduled-work boot, a local OIDC provider fixture, and a scratch PostgreSQL 16 on 127.0.0.1:44790.
  - **Resume mechanics.** The dead run's partial screenshots were moved aside and are not cited. Resumed lane-C boots use the `http://localhost` origin, because `127.0.0.1` answers 403 `INVALID_ORIGIN` on sign-in. Native `confirm()` dialogs were accepted explicitly through `page.on('dialog')`. Pins touched by the restart were re-run fresh under the lock.
  - **Time split** (environment vs test driving, minutes, the lanes' estimates): A 17 / 103 (resumed portion only), B ≈38 / 220, C ≈34 / 190.

## Fails — reproduction rules and dispositions

### Product defects

**platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render · A2** (P0 item): product defect, objectstack-ai/objectui#12285.
1. Boot the stock showcase. Sign in through the form as the member `phone.demo@example.com` / `showcase123` (get-session 200, positions org_member, everyone).
2. Open `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup`, the package-id segment the admin's own Setup links use.
3. Network: `GET /api/v1/meta/app` 200 (setup absent), then `GET /api/v1/meta/app/com.objectstack.setup` → 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
- **Expected:** `[data-testid=app-access-denied]` "You don't have access to this app" (AppContent.tsx `accessVerdict==='denied'`, objectui#4252 / #8013).
- **Actual:** `[data-testid=app-not-found]` "This app can't be opened — The server did not return this app for your account". Seen on 2 fresh contexts.
- **Control:** a member-bearer `GET /api/v1/meta/app/setup` → 403 PERMISSION_DENIED. The by-name route keys on the app NAME, while the console probes with the ADR-0048 package-id segment (`AppContent.tsx` `probe.call(dataSource, appName)`). The denied branch is therefore unreachable from every canonical app URL. No Setup content leaks and the page is never blank.

**platform-core.console-installability-indicators · C2:** product defect, objectstack-ai/objectui#12295.
1. As admin on an app surface, "Connected" appears at 842 ms and is gone by 2874 ms (this half holds).
2. Stop the backend mid-session by killing the server's process group.
3. Poll the page every 0.5 s for 20 s for `Connected|Reconnecting|Disconnected|Connection error|Offline|Failed|Error`.
- **Expected:** a reconnecting or error chip that stays prominent while the backend is down.
- **Actual:** no chip at all. The Tasks grid shows stale data while background GETs fail with `net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`. Seen on 2 full stop/restart reproductions plus one emulated failure (Playwright aborting the api routes).
- **Self-check:** the same poller sees "Connected" on load and "Offline" under `setOffline`.
- **Mechanism:** `AppHeader.tsx:702` renders ConnectionStatus from the adapter's ConnectionState. `data-objectstack/src/index.ts:3360-3440` moves that state only inside `connect()`, the initial discovery. The hop range is empty for these files.

**records-forms.conditional-rules-grid · A4:** product defect, objectstack-ai/objectui#12286.
1. On a fresh boot, `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice_line?$filter=[["invoice","=","INV-1001 ID"]]` returns Consulting hours at position 0 and Widget A units at position 1.
2. Open `/_console/apps/showcase_app/showcase_invoice/record/INV-1001 ID/edit`. The grid reads `…showcase_invoice_line?top=500&filter=[invoice,=,ID]` with no orderby and renders server order (Widget A first).
3. Change only the Consulting hours Qty (`input[aria-label=Qty]`) from 10 to 11, then Save.
- **Expected:** only the edited line in the batch; Widget A byte-identical.
- **Actual:** `POST /api/v1/batch` carries an update for the untouched Widget A `{position:0}`. On re-read, Widget A moved 1 → 0 (updated_at bumped) and Consulting 0 → 1. Same on INV-1002, on 2 fresh loads.
- **Mechanism:** plugin-form `MasterDetailForm.tsx` `readLinesOf` calls `find(child, {$filter, $top:500})` with no sort by the derived sortField. fields `GridField.tsx` `emit()` stamps `row[sortField]=index` on every change. The hop range is empty. The add-line edit in `master-detail-atomic-save` showed the same re-stamp.
